title: San Francisco First Timer Tour Highlights and Hidden Gems
includes: All taxes, fees and handling charges
You must provide your own child seat and reserve a spot for the child (not included)
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
New to San Francisco and want to see it all in one trip? This first-timer's tour is built for travelers who want the famous landmarks plus the local corners most visitors walk right past. 

From a comfortable minivan with a local guide, you'll take in the Golden Gate Bridge, Coit Tower, the Painted Ladies, Alcatraz views, and the Palace of Fine Arts, then roll through neighborhoods like North Beach and Haight-Ashbury for the hidden gems only locals know to look for. 

In about four hours you'll get your bearings, cover the highlights, and leave with insider tips for the rest of your stay.
